scoreRationale.onboarding: Hosted use may be direct, while the detailed self-hosting account shows meaningful setup and identity friction, supporting 6.8.
scoreRationale.product: Publishing to more than 30 networks, AI, automation, API access, and open source provide strong breadth, supporting 8.0.
scoreRationale.support: The evidence packet did not establish consistent support quality, limiting the score to 6.5.
scoreRationale.billing: Open source and hosted choices provide flexibility, but infrastructure cost and current hosted prices were not fully documented, supporting 7.0.
scoreRationale.overall: Postiz offers broad social publishing and open control, while self-hosting complexity limits the score to 7.1.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Official claims of ease-of-use conflict with community reports of complex self-hosting
